semiconductor_relevance: High — 3S Silicon Tech., Inc. specializes in semiconductor packaging equipment, which is critical for the assembly and testing of semiconductor devices.
summary: 3S Silicon Tech., Inc. is a leading manufacturer of chip packaging equipment, providing high-reliability systems such as vacuum reflow ovens and die bonding equipment. The company focuses on delivering integrated solutions for power modules and wafer-level packages, catering to a diverse range of customers in the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, 3S Silicon Tech., Inc. serves a global customer base including IDMs, OSATs, and fabless companies.
